fields.description: For a panel PDF, select Panel Datasheet and BIS, then enter its brand and watt-peak.

fields.label: Equipment Brand
fields.description: Required for combined panel datasheet/BIS; must match the linked Solar Proposal panel brand. For other categories, blank applies to all brands.

fields.label: Panel Watt Peak (Wp)
fields.description: Enter the individual panel rating manually in Wp. Any positive whole number is allowed; it must match the Project Panel Watt Peak (Wp).

fields.label: Equipment Model
fields.description: Optional Item code. Selected only when that Item is present in the Project Material List.

fields.label: Document
fields.description: For Panel Datasheet and BIS, upload one PDF containing both documents.

fields.label: First PDF Page
fields.description: 1-based. Leave zero to start at the first page. Not used for QET.

fields.label: Last PDF Page
fields.description: Leave zero to include through the final page.
